response.sql: WITH per AS (SELECT transref, AVG(anlycount) AS avg_cnt FROM sentimentandfundamentals GROUP BY transref), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_cnt) AS overall_avg FROM per WHERE avg_cnt IS NOT NULL), kept AS (SELECT p.transref, p.avg_cnt, o.overall_avg FROM per p CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE p.avg_cnt > o.overall_avg), kept_avg AS (SELECT AVG(avg_cnt) AS kept_avg FROM kept) SELECT k.transref, k.avg_cnt AS avg_anlycount, k.avg_cnt - k.overall_avg AS diff_above_overall_avg, k.avg_cnt - ka.kept_avg AS diff_above_kept_avg FROM kept k CROSS JOIN kept_avg ka ORDER BY diff_above_kept_avg DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: The overall average is the unweighted mean of the per-transaction averages, excluding transactions whose average is NULL because all of their anlycount values are missing. The 'kept average' is the mean of the kept transactions' averages. 'How far above' is a signed difference (avg minus the reference), not a percentage.
